meta.purpose: Ergonomics tracker for motorized sit/stand desk — detects sitting/standing via VL53L1X ToF laser sensor, tracks sessions, nudges user to take breaks
meta.target-user: Single user (zentala) at a motorized sit/stand desk

hardware.sensor: Grove VL53L1X v2 — mounted under desk, pointing down to floor

feature.name: desk-state-detection
feature.description: Detects SITTING / STANDING / WALKING / AWAY based on sensor distance + keyboard/mouse activity
feature.debounce: 5 stable readings required before state change

feature.name: session-tracking
feature.description: Tracks sitting session duration, enforces 40-min default limit

feature.name: ui
feature.component: Shows current height or session warning

feature.name: persistence
feature.description: SQLite stores session history, today summaries

feature.name: settings
feature.description: Sit/stand limits, height calibration, notification prefs — persisted via tauri-plugin-store

feature.name: auto-connect
feature.description: Auto-detects zntl-desk-sensor v1 on serial ports via PING/PONG handshake

layer.name: firmware
layer.file: Arduino sketch for XIAO ESP32-C3 — reads VL53L1X, responds to PING with device ID, emits "distance: NNN mm" at 115200 baud

layer.name: rust-backend
layer.file: App entry — registers plugins, AppState, setup hook (tray, blur, serial)
Binary entry — calls lib::run()

All Tauri IPC commands: list_ports, start_auto_connect, stop_reading, get_session_state, set_session_limit, set_stand_limit, calibrate, get_settings, save_settings, get_today_summary, inject_reading (debug) + AppState struct definition
Core state machine — SessionManager, DeskState enum, break credit rules, alert firing, debounce, daily reset
Background serial reader — auto-detect device via PING/PONG, parse distance readings, emit Tauri events
Windows idle detection via GetLastInputInfo WinAPI
SQLite persistence — schema, session recording, TodaySummary queries
AppConfig struct — user settings persisted via tauri-plugin-store
System tray — dynamic icon, tooltip, context menu, left-click toggle
Wires desk:state-changed events to tray + overlay updates
Generates RGBA tray icons programmatically by state + progress
Progress ratio to green/yellow/red color mapping (thresholds 60%/85%)
Native WinAPI overlay window — 4px tall, full-width, always-on-top, CreateWindowExW, own message loop thread, shared OverlayState mutex

layer.name: react-frontend
layer.file: React DOM root — mounts App
Root component — orchestrates useDesk, useTimer, renders all panels
Shared TypeScript types: DeskState, SessionStateDto, TodaySummaryDto, etc.

dir.name: components/
dir.file: Visual left-side accent bar — animates by deskHeightCm and state
Current sitting session timer and progress vs limit
Settings UI — limits, calibration, notification prefs
Today's total sitting, standing, position change count

dir.name: hooks/
dir.file: Main data hook — subscribes to desk:* events, fetches initial state
Tick hook — increments counter every second when running

dir.name: overlay/
dir.file: Canvas-based overlay entry — listens for overlay:progress events

layer.name: unit
layer.rust: Session state machine transitions, break credit rules, daily reset, alerts, height calculation
layer.typescript: Components (ProgressBar, SessionProgress, SettingsPanel, HeightRail), hooks (useDesk), utils (format)

layer.name: integration
layer.file: Full sitting/standing flow via inject_reading IPC
Device disconnect/reconnect handling
layer.note: App must be running: pnpm tauri:dev in another terminal

layer.name: e2e
layer.file: App loads, UI elements visible
Session state, progress bar, tray tooltip

layer.name: performance
layer.file: Memory sampling vs .perf-baseline.json (peak less than 250MB)

config-files.file: Window config (520x640, transparent, no decorations), bundle, CSP
Rust deps: tauri2, rusqlite, serialport, chrono, tokio, window-vibrancy, windows
Vite build + Vitest unit config, 80% coverage gate
